# The RPC contract

<!-- Generated by protocol/generate_docs.py from protocol/*.fbs: do not edit. -->

The RPCs by which the UI, the Web and the Agent talk to `tsugumid`, generated from the doc comments of [protocol/tsugumi.fbs](../../protocol/tsugumi.fbs).

- **Format**: one message is one FlatBuffer (root `Tsugumi.RPC.Message`, file identifier `TSG1`). The WebSocket subprotocol is `tsugumi.rpc.v1`; on a Unix socket, a 4-byte length (little endian) is followed by the body.
- **Failure**: any request may be answered with `Failure`.
- **Requests that change something**: carry an `op_id`, and a resend with the same `op_id` is applied only once. If a response is lost, check with `OperationGet`.
- **The Agent's tools**: made from the same schema (`tsugumi.bfbs`) ([Agent service](Agent.md)).

Layout proposals, layout schema validation and minimap placement belong to the host service ([protocol/host.fbs](../../protocol/host.fbs)). Saving clients remove deleted Card references. The project core carries layout objects and opaque view JSON without interpreting presentation fields.

The shared Unix and WebSocket transport limits each connection to 64 MiB of pending send data. A connection that would exceed the limit is closed. The Project and Host endpoints limit pending requests to 256, with eight additional slots for classified control requests. Requests beyond the limit receive a `busy` failure.

See [run recovery](RunStorage.md#interrupted-runs), [worker reconnection](RemoteWorker.md#host-authorization-and-following-a-run) and [checkout recovery](VersionRecords.md#checkout-journal-and-recovery) for process and transaction lifetimes.

There are 55 requests.

## Running

| --- | --- | --- |
| [`RunPlan`](#runplan) | RunPlanResult | Preview the Cards a run reaches; propagate defaults to true. |

An active run lists its Cards in progress with their stage, what a remote execution waits for or builds, the derivations being built, CPU time and time since their last output. |

## Views

| Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ViewSave`](#viewsave) | ViewSaveResult | CAS on view_rev only. |
| [`CardViewRead`](#cardviewread) | FileContent | Read a page of the immutable view file pinned by the open session. Only its presenting subscription may read it. FileContent.name is the declared view name and hash is the Nix store path. offset defaults to 0 and limit_bytes defaults to 1 MiB (1..1048576). This RPC is transient. |
| [`ViewSend`](#viewsend) | Ack | Send opaque bytes to live processes of a Card registered on this window. The address is a project-root Card path or "*" for all registered Cards. An address without a live recipient returns an error. |
| [`ViewCredit`](#viewcredit) | Ack | Return display capacity after the UI forwards or discards a message. |
| [`ViewClose`](#viewclose) | Ack | Close a view owned by this subscription. Each live route receives one close event. Repeating a completed close has no effect. |

## Notifications

Sent from `tsugumid` to connected clients.

- `DocPatched`
- `RunEvent`
- `DisplayUpdated`
- `LogAvailable`
- `TraceChanged`
- `RunCategoryDeleteResult`
- `ViewOpened`
- `ViewRecipientChanged`
- `ViewClosed`

Card views open through the Card ABI. The presenting subscription receives
`ViewOpened` before any `DisplayUpdated` for the session and owns the
file reads, sends, credits and close. `ViewRecipientChanged` reports when
a Card path gains its first live recipient or loses its last one on a window.
The presenting subscription receives `ViewClosed` when the window closes.
Session IDs use canonical UUID text. View RPCs
and notifications are excluded from RPC traces.

### Run events

The `value` inside a `RunEvent` has one of these types.

- `RunAcceptedEvent`
- `RunStatusChanged`
- `RunCardChanged`
- `RunTimeline`
- `RunFinished`
- `RunBatchChanged`

## Host and Agent service contracts

Both services include [service_common.fbs](../../protocol/service_common.fbs): Hello, Failure, Acknowledgement, ProviderSelection, Access, PermissionKind, Usage and TextResult have one definition. Secret ProviderInput belongs only to Host.

Agent keeps conversations, turns, tools and conversation access prompts. Host keeps shared operations, including reference demos and version notes; model use does not decide the contract. External Agents read demos through ToolCall (demo_list/demo_read), not direct Host RPC.

### Agent service

Separate listener: `TSA1`, WebSocket subprotocol `tsugumi.agent.v1`; authenticated principals: user and external.

| --- | --- |

| `ConfigureRequest` | `provider: Tsugumi.Service.ProviderSelection` (required), `conversation_id: string` (required) |
